# Datamarcos

> Live-online AI and data engineering training for working professionals, based in Noida, India. Founded in 2021, serving learners in India and worldwide.

Datamarcos runs live, mentor-led online programs led by founder Deepesh Mishra, and also trains teams at organizations.

## Programs

- [Forward Deployed AI Engineer](https://www.datamarcos.com/programs/forward-deployed-ai-engineer): 22 weeks. For working engineers: scope, build, secure and deploy production AI (RAG, agents, MCP, LLMOps) through four client-style engagements.
- [Generative AI & Agentic AI Engineer](https://www.datamarcos.com/programs/genai-agentic-ai-engineer): 18 weeks. Build, evaluate, secure and deploy GenAI and agentic AI systems, with three client-style projects and a capstone.
- [Applied Agentic AI Certification](https://www.datamarcos.com/programs/applied-agentic-ai-certification): 8 weeks. RAG, tool-using agents, multi-agent workflows and automation, with a project every module and a capstone; no prior AI experience needed.
- [Advance Data Engineering with Applied GenAI & Agentic AI](https://www.datamarcos.com/programs/advance-data-engineering-genai): 4+ months. A cloud data engineering foundation (Python, SQL, Azure, PySpark, Databricks, streaming), then an advanced track in RAG, agents and an integrated capstone.
